description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component for managing device and app settings within an Android application, including permissions, notifications, location, and device info.

classes.name: InstalledApp
classes.description: Data class representing an installed application's label, package name, and system app status.

methods.name: queryInstalledApps
methods.description: Queries the device for installed launchable apps, filtered by notification and configuration.

methods.name: resolveNotificationCandidatePackages
methods.description: Resolves package names for notification forwarding, excluding the current app.

methods.name: settingsTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color scheme for text fields in settings.

methods.name: Modifier.settingsRowModifier
methods.description: Extension function to style setting row containers with border and background.

methods.name: settingsPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Defines button color scheme for primary actions.

methods.name: settingsDangerButtonColors
methods.description: Defines button color scheme for dangerous actions.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the application detail settings in system settings.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens the notification listener access settings.

methods.name: hasNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to post notifications.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener access is enabled.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Checks for the presence of motion sensors.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the role for Android assistant is available.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleHeld
methods.description: Checks if the app currently holds the Assistant role.
